name: Recast
description: Shows the people, places, events, papers and products a page describes, and lets you press pieces from different tabs into one object and place it. Runs only on tabs where you invoke it. Nothing leaves your device.

action.default_title: Recast: what is on this page?

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; connect-src 'none'

recast-clay.description: Bring Recast into this tab (then Control twice turns it on, Control once turns it off)
